title: Punch Off
description:
Two [gold]Punch Constructs[/gold] are duking it out and you see some treasure in between them...

Should you try to nab it?

options.title: Nab
options.description: Add [red]Injury[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].

notes: Choosing [gold]I Can Take Them[/gold] initiates combat against the two Punch Constructs. [gold]Greater Rewards[/gold] consist of 1 [gold]Relic[/gold] and 1 [gold]Potion[/gold] per player after victory.
